definition: The offline half of RAG: parsing source documents (PDF, HTML, DOCX, scans), cleaning, chunking, enriching with metadata, embedding, and indexing.
details: The offline half of RAG: parsing source documents (PDF, HTML, DOCX, scans), cleaning, chunking, enriching with metadata, embedding, and indexing. Most real-world RAG failures trace back to ingestion (bad parsing, broken tables, lost structure) rather than the model.
